# BrickAtlas

> Independent price tracker and discovery tool for LEGO® sets. Compare prices across stores, track sets you own, find deals, and explore the catalog by theme, interest or release window.

BrickAtlas is not affiliated with The LEGO Group. LEGO® is a trademark of the LEGO Group.

The site is available in eight languages (English, Polish, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Japanese, Chinese). The default URL (no prefix) serves English; other languages live at `/pl/`, `/de/`, `/fr/`, `/es/`, `/it/`, `/ja/`, `/zh/`.

## Browse the catalog

- [LEGO catalog](https://brickatlas.shop/lego): full set catalog with filters for theme, year, age, piece count and price
- [Sets on sale](https://brickatlas.shop/lego/on-sale): sets where the lowest store offer beats the official LEGO price
- [Shop by interest](https://brickatlas.shop/interests): curated entry points — Star Wars, Harry Potter, Adults Welcome, Polybags, Seasonal, and more

## Curated categories

- [Magazine sets](https://brickatlas.shop/lego/magazines): mini-builds bundled with collectible LEGO magazines
- [LEGO Exclusive](https://brickatlas.shop/lego/exclusive): sets sold only through LEGO.com and brand stores
- [Retiring soon](https://brickatlas.shop/lego/retiring-soon): sets approaching their official retirement date

## Reference

- [FAQ](https://brickatlas.shop/faq): how prices work, account, wishlist, reviews, privacy
- [LEGO glossary](https://brickatlas.shop/glossary): AFOL acronyms and community slang (AFOL, MOC, SNOT, UCS, MISB, etc.)
- [About BrickAtlas](https://brickatlas.shop/about): what we do and how
- [Contact](https://brickatlas.shop/contact): get in touch

## Data sources

- Set catalog, parts, minifigure and theme data come from the LEGO catalog and from community databases (notably Rebrickable)
- Offer data is collected from supported stores and refreshed regularly
- Reviews are written by signed-in BrickAtlas users (Quick rating or Detailed 6-dimension review)

## Sitemap

- [XML sitemap index](https://brickatlas.shop/sitemap.xml): full index of all pages with hreflang alternates for 8 languages

## Optional

- [Set pages](https://brickatlas.shop/lego/{slug}): individual set details with images, specs, store offers and user reviews — slug format is `<name>-<set-number>`
- [Theme pages](https://brickatlas.shop/lego/theme/{slug}): set listings filtered by theme
- [Tag pages](https://brickatlas.shop/lego/tag/{slug}): set listings filtered by community tag
- [Minifigure pages](https://brickatlas.shop/lego/minifig/{number}): list of sets containing a given minifigure
